common.disclaimer: Tartib is a tracking and discipline tool. It does not provide investment advice, trading signals or profit guarantees.

seo.title: Tartib — trading discipline and trader's journal
seo.description: Tartib helps traders manage risk, keep a trade journal and measure the cost of breaking their own trading rules.

hero.title: Trade by your rules, not by emotions.
hero.subtitle: Tartib helps traders control risk, keep a trade journal and see the real price of their mistakes.

pillars.title: Don't guess the market. Control yourself.

risk.title: Risk control
risk.text: Calculate position size, potential loss and the risk-to-reward ratio before you enter a trade.

discipline.title: Discipline
discipline.text: Set your own rules and see how honestly you follow them. Tartib warns you when a trade breaks them.

cost.title: Cost of mistakes
cost.text: See in money how much breaking your own rules has cost you — based on your own data.

demo.title: Price of discipline
demo.text: Tartib shows not only the result of your trades, but the result of your decisions.
demo.note: An illustrative example. The numbers do not reflect real results.

step1.title: Create rules
step1.text: Maximum risk, leverage, minimum R:R — whatever matters to you.

step2.title: Calculate the trade
step2.text: The calculator shows risk, loss and profit, and warns about rule violations.

step3.title: Record the result
step3.text: Add the trade to your journal with the emotion and the reason for entry.

step4.title: Analyze discipline
step4.text: Review statistics and the cost of violations to understand your mistakes.

pricing.title: Start for free
pricing.subtitle: The free plan is enough to feel the difference.

cta.title: Ready to trade with awareness?
cta.text: Create an account in a minute and add your first rules.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Pick what suits you. Payments are not connected yet.
